description: This file defines the interface ProductOptionService, which extends a generic service interface and declares methods for managing product options within a retailer's catalog, including listing options by store and language, retrieving by name or code, and saving or updating product options.

classes.name: ProductOptionService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService for managing ProductOption entities, providing methods to list, retrieve, and save product option data.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOption objects associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches ProductOptions matching a given name within a specific store and language context.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new ProductOption or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Lists ProductOptions in a read-only manner for a given store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by its unique code within a store context.
